description: Classic SaaS/product layout: navbar with centered links and dual pill CTAs, centered hero headline with inline icon accents over the video, then light solid sections below (asymmetric feature grid, two-tier pricing, dark footer). Clean, trustworthy, product-focused.
prompt_template:
LAYOUT SKELETON — structure and motion only. All names, copy, fonts, and colors come from the Build Brief above; this skeleton contains none.

HERO (min-h-[100dvh], relative, overflow-hidden): the background <video> per the mode rules, then a relative z-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto column. The navbar AND all hero content below render INSIDE this section, overlaid on the video — the hero is never a bare video with the text starting underneath it.

NAVBAR (inside hero, px-5 sm:px-8 py-5, flex justify-between): logo (simple inline-SVG glyph + wordmark) left; 4-5 text links center (desktop only, text-sm font-medium, hover:opacity-70); right side two pill buttons — one solid accent, one soft neutral (text-sm font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full). Mobile: hamburger (Lucide Menu/X) opening a Framer Motion slide-in sheet from the right (backdrop blur overlay + staggered link entrance + full-width CTA buttons at the bottom).

HERO CONTENT (centered, max-w-2xl mx-auto, generous top padding): an <h1> at clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 3.2rem), tight leading, with 2-3 small inline Lucide icons embedded between words (inline, vertical-align middle) as a playful accent; below it a short subtext paragraph (80% opacity, max-w-xl); below that one pill CTA with a trailing arrow icon. All three fade-up in sequence (shared Framer Motion variant const annotated with the Variants type, delay i*0.15).

FEATURES SECTION (solid light or dark background per brief, py-24+, max-w-6xl): eyebrow label + section heading left-aligned, then an asymmetric grid — one wide cell spanning 2 columns + two normal cells (NOT three identical cards). Cells use thin borders or subtle background tint, a single Lucide icon in the accent color, title, 2 lines of copy.

PRICING SECTION (contrasting solid background, py-24): heading centered, then two tier panels side by side (max-w-4xl). Highlight one tier with a 1px accent border and slightly raised layout; simple check-list rows (Lucide Check). No heavy shadows.

FOOTER (dark solid background): 4-column link grid + bottom copyright row with thin top border. Social links use generic icons (Globe, Mail, MessageCircle) only.

MOTION: fade-up whileInView on section entries, hover scale 1.03 / tap 0.97 on buttons. Subtle only.

description: Editorial layout: hero content pinned to the bottom-left corner over the video with a tiny top nav, then alternating solid sections below with numbered rows and a big stats strip. Confident, magazine-like, good for studios/agencies/premium brands.
prompt_template:
LAYOUT SKELETON — structure and motion only. All names, copy, fonts, and colors come from the Build Brief above; this skeleton contains none.

HERO (min-h-[100dvh], relative, overflow-hidden): background <video> per mode rules; content in a relative z-10 h-[100dvh] flex column justify-between p-6 md:p-10. The top bar AND the hero content render INSIDE this section, overlaid on the video — never in a section below it.

TOP BAR: single row — small wordmark left; 3-4 tiny uppercase tracking-widest links + one text-link CTA with arrow right. No pills, no borders — ultra minimal.

HERO CONTENT (bottom-left): an eyebrow line (small uppercase, accent color), then an oversized display headline at clamp(2.5rem, 8vw, 7rem) spanning up to 2 lines, tight leading; to its right on desktop (grid md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] items-end) a short max-w-xs paragraph at 70% opacity and a small underlined text CTA. Fade-up stagger on load.

SECTION 1 — NUMBERED ROWS (solid background per brief, py-28, max-w-5xl): small eyebrow + large section heading, then 4 full-width rows, each with a 1px top border: two-digit number (mono/small), row title (large), one-line description right-aligned on desktop. Rows fade in sequentially whileInView; on hover the row's number switches to the accent color.

SECTION 2 — STATS STRIP (contrasting solid background, py-20): a single row (grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) of big numbers at clamp sizes with tiny uppercase labels beneath, separated by thin 1px vertical borders. Numbers count up whileInView (small useEffect counter).

SECTION 3 — STATEMENT + CTA (back to first background, py-32, centered): one max-w-3xl statement heading with 1-2 accent-colored words, then a single pill CTA.

FOOTER (darkest solid background): top row — very large wordmark; middle row — 3 link columns; bottom row — thin top border, copyright left, generic social icons (Globe, Mail) right.

MOTION: whileInView fade/slide only; count-up stats; underline-expand hover on text CTAs.

description: Ultra-minimal layout: one centered statement over the video with a floating micro-nav, then sparse, airy sections below built almost entirely from typography and thin dividers. Calm, luxurious, gallery-like. Best for portfolios, wellness, boutique brands.
prompt_template:
LAYOUT SKELETON — structure and motion only. All names, copy, fonts, and colors come from the Build Brief above; this skeleton contains none.

HERO (min-h-[100dvh], relative, overflow-hidden): background <video> per mode rules; content in a relative z-10 h-[100dvh] flex items-center justify-center. The micro-nav AND the hero statement render INSIDE this section, overlaid on the video — never in a section below it.

FLOATING MICRO-NAV (absolute top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2): a single small translucent pill (backdrop-blur, 1px white/15 border, rounded-full, px-6 py-2.5) containing the wordmark and 2-3 tiny links separated by generous spacing. Nothing else at the top.

HERO CONTENT (centered, text-center): one statement headline at clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 5rem), max 6-8 words across up to 2 lines, with a per-word fade-up stagger on load; beneath it a single short line at 70% opacity.

SECTIONS BELOW (all share one calm solid background; alternate only by spacing, never by color blocks):
1. INTRO (py-32, max-w-2xl mx-auto, centered): eyebrow, then a medium statement heading, then one paragraph. A thin 1px divider (mx-auto w-16) above and below.
2. OFFERINGS (py-28, max-w-4xl): a vertical list of 3-4 entries, each just: large title on the left, one-line description on the right, 1px bottom border. On hover the title slides 8px right and an arrow fades in. No boxes, no cards.
3. QUOTE/PHILOSOPHY (py-32, centered): one large italic or serif line at 80% opacity, max-w-3xl, with oversized decorative quotation marks rendered as text.
4. CTA (py-28, centered): short heading + one pill button. Nothing else.

FOOTER: single centered column — small wordmark, one row of tiny links, copyright at 50% opacity. Generous py-16, thin top border.

MOTION: slow, calm — 0.6-0.8s fades, whileInView once:true, hover slide on list rows. Nothing fast or springy.
